brand.title: Bách Mã Viên: a symbol of freedom, courage and loyalty
brand.p1: Inspired by Bách Mã, a hundred horses running across an endless plain, Bách Mã Viên was built as an elegant refuge for souls who long for unspoiled freedom.
brand.p2: Every brick and every rough-cut timber is handcrafted to honor the bond between rider and horse. The stables, with their signature curved architecture, let natural light in while the breeze from the Cổ Cò river gently soothes each precious animal to rest.
brand.imageCaption: A curved timber roof wraps the stable aisle, drawing clean air in from the Cổ Cò river.
brand.quote: At Bách Mã Viên every stop is a new experience and every step is a story waiting to be discovered, a place where people relearn empathy from the eyes of a horse.

pillars.title: Three Signature Pillars for Our Guests
pillars.description: Carefully designed, from your very first lesson to wild, cinematic frames in true Wild West style.

basics.title: Beginner Riding and Core Skills
basics.text: Coached one-to-one by a seasoned trainer. Learn to keep your balance, hold the reins with proper posture and understand a horse's body language.

wildWest.title: Wild West Cowboy Style
wildWest.text: Put on a weathered leather vest, a felt hat and classic riding boots. Feel the rhythm of the ride on an international-standard arena beside the untamed river.
wildWest.point1: Authentic Wild West outfit and accessories

photo.title: Cinematic Editorial Photo Tour
photo.text: Golden-hour light paints the Cổ Cò river. A professional crew captures cinematic frames with our well-trained horses.
photo.point1: Dressing room and supporting horses included

welfare.title: We don't just train horses, we connect souls
welfare.text: At Bách Mã Viên a horse is never just a tool for an experience. They are friends and proud partners. Our care philosophy rests on patience, understanding and respect for natural behavior.

nutrition.label: Nutrition Plan
nutrition.text: Selected hay with specialized mineral feed, tailored to each horse's age and condition.

vet.label: Resident Veterinarian
vet.text: A full check-up every 2 weeks, monitoring heart health and a safe exercise routine.

communication.title: Communication Without Coercion
communication.text: Training built on positive reflexes and mutual trust between trainer and horse.

grooming.title: Therapeutic Bathing and Grooming
grooming.text: Guests are guided to stroke, brush the mane and feed the horses, nurturing compassion.

rest.title: Natural Rest in the Pasture
rest.text: Strict limits on daily working hours keep every horse's energy and spirit at their best.

team.title: The People Behind the Bách Mã Viên Mission

leadership.title: Setting the Standard for Prairie Living
leadership.text: Cultural tourism managers and equestrian sport specialists working toward an elegant, internationally recognized destination on the central coast.

trainers.title: Perfect Harmony Between Rider and Horse
trainers.text: Experienced riders accompany every session, so each guest feels safe and inspired.

cta.title: Ready for Your First Wild West Stride?
cta.text: Take time to listen to the Cổ Cò breeze and feel the free spirit of the saddle. Daily places are limited to guarantee the very best service.
cta.cardText: So our concierge team and head trainer can prepare everything for you.
cta.location: Cổ Cò riverside, Đà Nẵng – Hội An
